title: task-outcome-schema
rawUserRequest: Implement Work Item 13 task-outcome-schema from the Interactive Installation and Calibration Wizard plan: define the machine-readable Task Outcome Report JSON Schema with empty-array support and provenance bindings, plus schema-focused tests.

declaredIntent.summary: Establish the versioned machine-readable contract for Task Outcome Reports before events, generation, validation, or integration are implemented.

outOfScope: Task Outcome event-log storage and correction semantics
Outcome JSON/Markdown generation, validation CLI, Cockpit Status, PR-summary, archive, or release integration
Changing existing Contract, Summary, Verification, or Trust schemas
Adding production runtime behavior beyond the schema artifact

sources.reason: Canonical WI13 requirements for machine truth, provenance bindings, statuses, findings, risks, and report sections.
Project reporting language and repository capability configuration.
Existing schema validation conventions and privacy-oriented schema guard patterns.
Existing schema test style and invalid-payload coverage.

riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item adds a standalone schema and tests; later generators and validators must bind to this contract without weakening required provenance or visibility fields.

executionDecision.reason: Schema boundary, required bindings, empty-array behavior, and out-of-scope integrations are explicit.

preReviewWarnings: Review schema requiredness, enum boundaries, digest/commit formats, empty-array validity, and separation from later generator/validator Work Items.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: `.ai/schemas/task_outcome.schema.json` is a versioned JSON Schema whose valid minimum report permits empty arrays in every repeatable report section.
The schema requires English JSON keys and binds Task ID, Contract/Summary/Verification SHA-256 digests, base/head commits, PR identity, AI Cockpit version, and generator version.

The schema models the five final statuses, requested finding/risk/intervention/stop/resolution/prevention categories, severity and final-state enums, and explicit residual-risk visibility without score or unsupported-quantification fields.
Schema-focused tests cover required bindings, valid minimum/complete payloads, invalid status/severity/level/digest/commit values, empty sections, and rejection of unsupported score fields.
AI governance, quality, scope, documentation metadata, and complete PR/merge/closure lifecycle checks pass; event, generator, validator, multilingual, and release behavior remain out of scope.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The Task Outcome Report extension needs a stable machine-readable contract before append-only events and derived JSON/Markdown reports can be implemented. Without a schema, later Work Items could disagree on provenance bindings, empty reports, statuses, severity levels, or residual-risk visibility.
constraints: Keep Cockpit Status separate from the evidence-backed Outcome Report and do not add scores, praise, productivity claims, or unsupported quantities.
Use English JSON keys and preserve one machine-truth shape; later Work Items own events, generation, validation, rendering, and integrations.
Require provenance and repository identity bindings while allowing valid empty arrays so no-finding and no-intervention tasks are representable.
intent.rationale: A strict standalone schema gives the later serial Work Items one compatibility boundary for evidence, provenance, privacy, and residual-risk visibility without prematurely coupling runtime integrations.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: No score or unsupported quantification field
